Hi

I've been carrying around some ideas around strengthening ETH as a native asset, and now I took the time to write them down and develop them. With the intention that they could be EIPs.

I'm looking for friendly technical feedback on feasibility, gas, state management, and prior-art gaps before circulating more widely. As well as a bit of mentoring around the process, since I'm not a core dev but just a node operator.

Please reach out via dm if you think you want to help
